dedupe_keys.name: a e attendance in london by day and hour greater london authority night time observatory

description: This dataset gives annual accident and emergency attendance in London by time of day, as numbers and percentages of attendances. The Greater London Authority publishes it on the London Datastore as part of its Night Time Observatory, which tracks London's night-time economy and services. The official item page names Public Health England as author and NHS Digital Hospital Episode Statistics as the source. Its a-and-e-admissions.xlsx file covers January 2007 through December 2017. The figures describe how emergency department demand is spread across the 24 hours, including the share of attendances at night. The item page labels the file Open Government Licence v3 and offers it as a free download. Caveats: counts are aggregated for London as a whole, so single hospitals cannot be separated, the source figures come from NHS statistics with their own coding changes, and attendance measures demand, not capacity. Simulation uses: building hour-of-day arrival profiles for emergency department and ambulance simulation models, and testing night-time surge scenarios. Related records: the treat-sim discrete event model (model-treat-sim-treatment-centre-des) uses such arrival profiles, and FDNY EMS incident dispatch data (data-nyc-fdny-ems-incident-dispatch) give pre-hospital demand in another large city.
